channel.title: mint - companies
channel.description: Get the latest news and analysis on business, finance, politics from mint, the website of the Mint newspaper, one of India's leading business and financial dailies

item.title: Elon Musk says SpaceX closed $40 billion debt deal for AI chips as firm ‘investment grade, has Starlink, launch revenue’
item.description: SpaceX has closed a $40 billion debt deal to buy Nvidia GPUs for its AI data centers. Billionaire Elon Musk said the company's investment grade, Starlink and launch revenue will support the borrowing.

item.title: IIFL Capital hires four Barclays bankers to expand wealth business
item.description: The Fairfax-controlled firm is stepping up its push to attract wealthy Indian families as competition intensifies and global banks restructure their workforces.

item.title: JSW MG taps into Chinese parent Saic for 70% of its purchases
item.description: Nearly 70% of the joint venture’s purchases in the financial year 2026 came from Saic-linked firms, taking their total business with the Indian carmaker to about $840 million, including royalty and licence fee

item.title: Eternal’s District explores live-event venues to cut concert costs, counter AI threat
item.description: The out-of-home consumption platform is exploring partnerships with property owners and governments to build dedicated venues as it seeks to scale its events business and strengthen its defences against AI-led disruption.

item.title: Wow! Momo plans ₹300 crore fundraise, eyes overseas expansion ahead of proposed IPO
item.description: The Kolkata-based QSR chain plans to enter Sri Lanka this year and explore the UAE, while scaling its packaged-food business and targeting ₹1,050 crore in FY27 revenue.

item.title: Introducing Lab Rats: A Mint series on India’s biotech startups
item.description: India’s drug innovation story has so far been told through the lens of established pharmaceutical companies. But a new generation of biotech startups is attempting bolder feats with a fraction of the funding.

item.title: Katrina Kaif’s Kay Beauty hits ₹350 cr valuation, completing one year in UK's retail market with luxury chain Space NK
item.description: Katrina Kaif’s Kay Beauty has crossed ₹350 crore in gross merchandise value as it expands internationally through British luxury beauty retailer Space NK. The brand, launched with Nykaa in 2019, is growing its presence beyond India.

item.title: Who ordered Starlink speed restrictions on Ukraine? Elon Musk reveals why SpaceX throttled service
item.description: Elon Musk acknowledged that SpaceX restricted Starlink speeds in Ukraine, alleging the military violated its terms of service by using the network for offensive drone strikes. Services have since been restored, with Trump confirming he spoke to Musk about easing restrictions.

item.title: Who is Kuldeep Sehrawat? Former IBM executive joins Wipro as director and head of marketing for India
item.description: Wipro has appointed Kuldeep Sehrawat as director and head of marketing for India. Sehrawat joins from IBM, where he spent over eight years in marketing leadership roles focused on business growth, demand generation and partner ecosystems.

item.title: Instacart explores potential sale, holds preliminary talks with Uber and DoorDash: Here's all about the deal
item.description: Instacart is exploring a possible sale and has held preliminary discussions with Uber and DoorDash, as per a report. A deal could value the company at $16 billion to $17 billion, but talks are ongoing, no agreement is guaranteed, and regulators could scrutinize a transaction.

item.title: Who is Rithvik Jyothi Raj? Jailer 2 actor who plays Rajinikanth’s grandson runs a startup at 13, wants to write comics
item.description: Rithvik Jyothi Raj, 13, who plays Rajinikanth's grandson in Jailer and Jailer 2, has revealed that he runs a website-based venture with friends. The young actor also enjoys coding, robotics, and writing, with ambitions to become a comic book writer and filmmaker.&nbsp;

item.title: KFC US president Catherine Tan-Gillespie washed dishes at 13 for $1.20 an hour: Why she never chased money or big titles
item.description: Catherine Tan-Gillespie, president of KFC US, began her career washing dishes at 13 for £1.20 an hour. The 52-year-old executive says she built her career by pursuing challenging opportunities, taking risks and stepping outside her comfort zone rather than chasing money or job titles.

item.title: Navi Mumbai airport flights news: These two airlines set to shift flights from Mumbai airport starting December
item.description: The coordinated approach between IndiGo, Air India Express and AAHL reflects ongoing efforts to balance growth at both airports while preparing CSMIA for long-term upgrades.

item.title: CBI files bank fraud case against IL&FS Energy Development over alleged ₹212 crore loss to Canara Bank: Details here
item.description: The CBI has registered a case against IL&amp;FS Energy Development Company, its former managing director and other senior officials over an alleged ₹212.34 crore loss to Canara Bank. The FIR alleges that loan funds meant for renewable energy and infrastructure projects were diverted to other uses.

item.title: Shree Naman Group steps up hotel buys, targets 2,500 rooms in five years
item.description: Shree Naman Group is expanding beyond its home market through acquisitions and new projects, as real estate groups deepen their hospitality bets

item.title: JSW Steel flags domestic raw material bottlenecks as India eyes 600 mt capacity
item.description: Jayant Acharya, joint managing director and CEO of JSW Steel, calls for faster iron ore mining and coal washery investments to support India's long-term capacity push, even as JSW prioritises brownfield projects over green steel.

item.title: Tata Sons listing latest news: How RBI Governor Sanjay Malhotra's first public comment dispels doubts on Sept 11 order
item.description: RBI Governor Sanjay Malhotra said large NBFCs and core investment companies with direct or indirect access to public funds must register with the central bank. Since Tata Sons is classified as an upper-layer NBFC, the RBI rejected its attempt to surrender its licence, making a public listing likely.

item.title: Who is Luis Davila? Google appoints former Schneider executive to lead strategic communications for sustainability
item.description: Luis Davila will lead Google’s strategic sustainability communications after roles at Schneider Electric, Amazon and the UNFCCC. The move comes amid backlash over AI data centers, whose energy and water demands have raised concerns about pressure on local supplies.

item.title: How Gen Z is driving festival travel trend: Hotel bookings up 135% for Diwali—Bangalore, Jaipur, Taipei, Cebu see growth
item.description: Cleartrip’s festive-season tracker found travel demand shifting beyond traditional hubs. Diwali leisure hotel bookings rose 135%, while bookings by travellers aged 15–24 increased 60%. Offbeat domestic and international destinations have strong growth.

item.title: Tata Motors stands firm on ₹1,531-per-share Iveco bid as investor questions valuation: All you need to know
item.description: Tata Motors has refused to raise its offer to buy Italian truck maker Iveco while investor who owns 3.8% of Iveco claims the price is too low. Tata Motors is expected to buy more than 80% of the company's shares by the deadline.

item.title: ‘You’ve got to do the right thing’: Gautam Singhania on losing family ties to protect Raymond amid public feuds
item.description: Raymond chief Gautam Singhania said he had lost family ties to protect the company, citing his responsibility towards 50,000 families dependent on the business.

item.title: Explained: How the Renault-Dumarey deal with Alpine Racing SAS has preserved 150 jobs at former F1 engine facility
item.description: Renault had ended its association with Formula 1 as an engine provider in 2025, thus marking the end of an era in motorsports history.&nbsp;

item.title: Google DeepMind Pentagon AI contract resignations: Researchers exit over classified military deals; all you need to know
item.description: The resignations arrive as the Pentagon pushes to integrate advanced AI across classified networks. For Google, the contracts are part of broader government business.

item.title: Fast-fashion group Shein agrees to pay $100 million to settle US FTC probe: What is the case? What really happened?
item.description: Chinese retain company Shein to pay a hefty price amid growing regulatory and tax pressures in the United States and Europe. The prices of its products are likely to increase in the same markets.

item.title: Etihad downgrades passenger from business to economy despite full payment - Here's what to do in case; how to get refund
item.description: An alleged apology letter issued by Etihad has emerged on X. The company has offered a 75% refund to the affected passengers. Check out rules by Directorate General of Civil Aviation (DGCA).

item.title: Infosys headcount rises by 4,480 in Q2FY27, freshers hiring crosses 8,000; check details
item.description: Voluntary attrition at Infosys moderated to 12.7 percent on a last-twelve-month basis, down from 13 percent in the previous quarter. The improvement suggests better employee retention as the industry navigates a phase of selective hiring and skill-specific demand.

item.title: Reliance Jio IPO: Who is Arjun Vaidya? Bizman shares why his friend Akash Ambani returned to India from US | Video
item.description: Entrepreneur and investor Arjun Vaidya recalled Akash Ambani’s 2013 decision to return to India. He said the company’s affordable internet transformed the startup ecosystem. Jio Platforms’ record ₹30,213-crore IPO drew strong investor demand.

item.title: CoinDCX confirms losses after sweep failure on compromised old wallets, says active addresses remain safe
item.description: Cofounder and CEO Sumit Gupta separately denied a fresh wallet breach. He said hackers appeared to be reusing the compromised addresses.

item.title: German drone maker Quantum Systems claims 483-mph speed for battery-powered experimental aircraft
item.description: However, the achievement has not yet been officially confirmed, as the aircraft must complete a return flight to account for the effects of wind

item.title: Meet Luana Lopes Lara: How a $22 billion prediction market startup made this 30-year-old a billionaire | Success story
item.description: Luana Lopes Lara, the 30-year-old co-founder of prediction market platform Kalshi, has an estimated net worth of $2.6 billion. Yet, the former professional ballet trainee says building her company remains a priority as Kalshi expands amid a sharp rise in its valuation and legal challenges in the US.

item.title: IDBI Bank sale: Employees’ service conditions to remain unchanged, says DIPAM Secretary
item.description: Staff, pensioners have ‘nothing to fear’ from ₹52,878 crore deal with Fairfax, says DIPAM Secretary Arunish Chawla

item.title: Volkswagen freezes India EV investment amid JSW talks: What the pause means for its electric car plans
item.description: Volkswagen has paused further investment in its India EV programme as it seeks clarity on a potential partnership with JSW Group. The automaker is weighing a locally produced, lower-cost EV platform amid global cost cuts and intensifying competition in India’s electric vehicle market.

item.title: Volkswagen has frozen India EV investments as JSW joint venture talks continue - What is next?
item.description: Volkswagen is pausing investment in an India electric-vehicle program until it has greater clarity on a potential partnership with JSW Group. The automaker has completed design work but needs a stronger business plan, local sourcing and production to make the vehicles cost-competitive.

item.title: Indian Overseas Bank privatisation: What is the buzz about? Centre's rules and regulations for the process, explained
item.description: While the Centre is considering reducing its stakes in four public sector banks to 75% to meet public-shareholding norms, it also plans to privatise at least two public lenders besides IDBI Bank. Here's a look at the rules and regulations for the process…&nbsp;

item.title: South Africa moves towards ₹5,400 crore takeover of Lakshmi Mittal’s struggling steel business: What’s in the deal?
item.description: South Africa is reportedly moving towards a ₹5,400 crore takeover of Lakshmi and Aditya Mittal’s steel business. Here is how the deal splits cash payments and debt, and what it means for the global steel giant.
